facts.fact: The Mouvement populaire group in the House of Representatives tabled a private member's bill regulating AI use that bars AI on social media from spreading false news, abusive speech or fabricated images and videos, bans unacceptable-risk systems from the market, and sets fines of MAD 50,000-500,000 and prison of 6 months to 5 years.
facts.system: Proposed law on regulating the use of artificial intelligence
